realFlow.model: actual configured provider; artifact generated during test

limits: Only JavaScript quicksort, one task; no complex projects, Python or agent chat.
Browser-reported checks are not exam-grade proof of algorithm choice.
Generation browser subprocess is bounded by 75 seconds; cancellation prevents publish.
